summary: Tests-only phase for issue #39. Committed at this head: (1) the upstream solver parity corpus from viamin/color_matching priv/parity/v1/corpus.json (algorithm_version 1, sha256 7b7b4d904ff369e1f5be0ec3a994d96cc996056e856d86a2b764b83c050f8604) vendored byte-for-byte as a test fixture; (2) SolverParityCorpusTests — a permanent suite asserting exact WeightedSquaredErrorScorer scores, missing-measurement exclusions, earliest-index-wins tie-breaking, tie evidence, and end-to-end CompositionSolver fast-path selections for all 12 corpus scenarios; (3) PaletteAPIClientContractTests — wire-contract characterization of /api/v1 that the generated OpenAPI-client migration must keep green; (4) OpenAPIClientMigrationTests — red guards requiring the vendored OpenAPI document and the swift-openapi-generator/swift-openapi-runtime package wiring; (5) docs/solver-parity-corpus.md — corpus location, refresh workflow, spec-vs-DTO shape findings, and the AC-to-verification plan. Swift toolchain is NOT installed in this container (bin/lint prints 'Swift toolchain not available; skipping build and tests' and exits 0), so swift test execution is deferred to a macOS host. Parity semantics were independently cross-verified with an equivalent Python replay of the corpus under the Swift scorer's rules: 12/12 scenarios exact (scores, exclusions, selections, ties, weight handling).
